newsitem.title: UK: UK GILTS UP MORE THAN 1/2 POINT ON BOE RATE RISE.
newsitem.headline: UK GILTS UP MORE THAN 1/2 POINT ON BOE RATE RISE.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE were up over half a point on Thursday after the Bank of England said it had raised official interest rates by 25 basis points to 7.0 percent.
The Bank said interest rates had reached the level consistent with Britain's RPIX inflation target, a comment the market interpreted as an indication rates had peaked for this cycle.
By 1116 GMT, September gilts were up 19/32 at 115-08, off an earlier high of 115-10. December short sterling was up 12 basis points on the day at 92.67, up from 92.59 before the news.
